visual_findings: Scanner RGB order appears plausible in all six. TCGA-EW-A6SB-01Z-00-DX1_003 shows the strongest virtual-DAPI/nuclear overlap and passes automated gates; protein specificity remains unproven. The other five show blur, diffuse virtual signal, or broad uneven shading. TCGA-MH-A560-01Z-00-DX2_3 has respectable global nuclear AUC yet fails spatial-shadow QC; its visible broad shading supports retaining that failure.
scope: Preview-scale inspection of cases 52-57 from an active 93-case CPU bundle. No protein-specific reference exists for these MoNuSAC fields.
